## [0.8.54+]
- **GNURUST.GNUCOBOL-TESTSUITE.4 + GNURUST.GNUCOBOL-TESTSUITE.BOUNDARY-REDUCTION.1 -- the three largest candidate boundaries measured, understood and reduced.** The module-model boundary (407 tests) was forensically decomposed (module-lifecycle census): ~400 were `$COBCRUN_DIRECT ./prog` launcher runs whose real first failure was a cobrun parse/check/runtime diagnostic -- the attribution is fixed so every test reports its TRUE boundary (same diagnostic, same class, on the syntax-only and run paths). An interpreted module lifecycle was implemented: silent `-m` artifacts, `cobcrun-rs` (`-M <dir>` / cwd / COB_LIBRARY_PATH search, cobcrun-shaped errors, program args via ACCEPT FROM COMMAND-LINE), runtime config loading with libcob-shaped errors + recursive-include detection + a resolved `--runtime-conf` (applied values, environment priority, `${...}` expansion), CALL across separately compiled modules, CANCEL state reset + the active-program fatal. Parser/check families: cobc-exact DISPLAY of numeric/E/binary/hex literals, level-78 constants + `01 ... CONSTANT [GLOBAL]`, USAGE BINARY-INT / FLOAT-* / HANDLE. New per-test dimensions: semantic_diagnostic_verdict + diagnostic_shape_parity. Measured after the final two-pass rerun: **193 OBSERVABLE_MATCH** (was 173), module-model 4 (was 407), 0 timeouts, 0 nondeterministic, all 1282 reconciled, determinism-identical; math subset 101 matches with the 323 invariant machine-enforced (the stale 22/21 prose discrepancy is corrected -- the ledger is the only source). New courts: GNURUST.MODULE.{REGISTRY,CALL,CANCEL,SEARCH,PARALLEL}.1, GNURUST.COBC-RS.{NATIVE-MODE-BOUNDARY,POLICY-COMPLETE}.1, GNURUST.GNUCOBOL-RUNTIME-MATH.2, GNURUST.GNUCOBOL-TESTSUITE.4, GNURUST.GNUCOBOL-TESTSUITE.BOUNDARY-REDUCTION.1 (160 courts total).
